title: Extract relative represented-matrix norm analysis
status_detail: Created by the human instruction `create these as tasks`. This records a proposed bounded comparison contract only; it does not choose zero-reference or compatibility policy.
objective: Extract repeated absolute and relative represented-matrix norm calculations into an explicit comparison result and ActionObject with declared zero-reference behavior.
authorized_scope: After separate explicit activation, define absolute difference norm, reference norm, relative ratio, compatible units, and zero-reference outcomes for represented matrices.
Require applicable represented-space compatibility before interpreting a relative matrix norm.
Migrate only consumers whose existing formula and zero-reference behavior exactly match the adopted contract.
completion_criteria: The result distinguishes absolute norm, scale, relative norm, and zero-reference outcome without non-finite sentinel ambiguity.
Compatibility, units, sign-independent norm semantics, typing, documentation, and tests agree.
Migrated retained outputs remain numerically unchanged.
exclusions: Do not use a relative norm to infer basis, gauge, energy-reference, geometry, or physical alignment.
Do not force campaign-specific acceptance thresholds into the generic comparison contract.
No scientific validation, uncertainty quantification, protected execution, release, publication, or automatic successor activation is authorized.
